characters.notes: _capcom_check.json lists no capcom_only or draft_only entries for Zangief, so there are no differences to resolve. The draft already holds the Screw Piledrivers, Borscht Dynamite (air only), Russian Suplex, Siberian Express, both throw supers and the OD Siberian Express armor. Missing: the three universal options (Drive cost not stated in either file), the two Double Lariats (head hurtbox gone from frame 1 per SuperCombo; OD is projectile-invincible from frame 1 per both sources) and Tundra Storm (a kick counter that starts on frame 5 or 6, so it fails the frame-3 threshold; listed so the profile owner can decide). Two draft entries are not usable against a grounded attacker: Aerial Russian Slam and Borscht Dynamite only hit airborne opponents (see additional_findings). Jump frames are not stated by Capcom. See additional_findings (extra key, same quote format) for near misses and three source discrepancies.
